name: a-reorder-hiding-inside-a-reword-is-caught
breaks: a review pass that reorders the alt texts AND rewords them slips through every other rule at once: the multiset comparison stops seeing a swap the moment the words change, the count is unchanged, and each entry still clears its word floor. Every description then ships beside the wrong photograph, which is the failure #1214 was filed for walking back in through the check written to stop it
